name: hall-tach
prompt: Build a wheel-speed sensor board: a hall-effect sensor feeding an ESP32 GPIO, with a 10k pull-up on the sensor output (it is open-collector) and a 100 nF decoupling capacitor across the sensor supply.
notes: Small but specific: the pull-up on OUT is functionally required (open-collector), and the decoupling cap is explicitly requested rather than left to taste.
